current_retry_semantics_verified.meaning: effective_max_retries=1 -> attempts 1,2 (initial attempt + 1 retry = 2 total); effective_max_retries=2 -> attempts 1,2,3 (initial attempt + 2 retries = 3 total)
current_retry_semantics_verified.off_by_one_check: Confirmed correct via 18 passing tests, including an explicit third-attempt-success fixture (model.calls==3, provider_attempt_count==3, retry_count==2) and an explicit alpha_classifier negative control (model.calls==2, unaffected).

global_ceiling_confirmation.evidence_stance_classifier_new_value_rel: EQUALS the ceiling exactly (2), does not exceed it

implementation.mechanism: New module-level constant EVIDENCE_STANCE_CLASSIFIER_MAX_RETRIES = min(2, MAX_SERVER_RETRIES) and a new function _resolve_task_max_retries(task, default_max_retries) called once, immediately before the existing retry loop in invoke_json_with_trace(). Only this one call site was changed -- the loop body, exception handling, logging, and every other method (including _invoke_json_legacy and invoke_prebuilt_json_prompt) are byte-identical to before.
implementation.resolver_semantics: task=='evidence_stance_classifier' AND default_max_retries>0 -> max(default_max_retries, 2); otherwise -> default_max_retries unchanged. An explicit default_max_retries==0 is respected as an intentional 'no retries at all' signal and is never raised, even for evidence_stance_classifier.
implementation.design_iteration_note: An initial unconditional-floor implementation (always return 2 for evidence_stance_classifier regardless of the caller's configured max_retries) was found, via the full backend suite, to break an existing narrow unit test (tests/llm_runtime/test_evidence_stance_classifier_registration.py::test_d_malformed_response_fails_closed_not_a_registry_error) that explicitly constructs a Gateway with max_retries=0 to isolate single-attempt validation-failure behavior. The resolver was corrected to respect an explicit zero, which fixes that regression while leaving the approved production behavior (1->2 at the .env-configured default of 1) unchanged.

historical_offline_counterfactual.methodology: Checked whether any of the 6 authoritative runs' evidence_stance_classifier final orphans (183 total) have a RECORDED 3rd-attempt outcome to replay.
historical_offline_counterfactual.finding: NONE -- max_retries=1 (2 total attempts) was the applied policy for all 7 historical runs (6 authoritative + TSM new validation); no attempt=3 was ever logged for evidence_stance_classifier in any of them.
historical_offline_counterfactual.classification: FUTURE_BENEFIT_UNKNOWN for all 183 historical evidence_stance_classifier final orphans -- explicitly NOT classified OBSERVED_RECOVERABLE, since that would require an actually-recorded 3rd-attempt outcome, which does not exist. This audit does not invent one.
